func TestHandlerGetLearnerOverviewReturnsBoundedProjection(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	lastSeenAt := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	handler := NewHandler(answerRepoStub{}, nil, nil, nil, learnerOverviewGetterStub{overview: domain.LearnerOverview{
		StudentID: studentID, Version: domain.LearnerOverviewVersion,
		RecentMastery: []domain.StudentTargetMastery{{
			StudentID: studentID,
			Target:    domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.interfaces"},
			State:     domain.TargetMasteryPracticed, FailureCount: 1, EvidenceCount: 1,
			LastSeenAt: lastSeenAt, PolicyVersion: domain.MasteryPolicyVersion,
		}},
	}})
	router := NewRouter(handler, "internal-token")
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/students/"+studentID+"/learner-overview", nil)
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "internal-token")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	if bytes.Contains(response.Body.Bytes(), []byte("evidence_rows")) || !bytes.Contains(response.Body.Bytes(), []byte("go.interfaces")) {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected learner overview body: %s", response.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestHandlerGetStudentPlanningReadinessRequiresInternalToken(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	emptyStacks := []string{}
	getter := &planningReadinessGetterStub{result: domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{
		Schema: domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshotSchema, StudentID: studentID,
		StateRef: domain.StudentPlanningReadinessStateRef{Kind: "none", Version: 0},
		Profile: domain.StudentPlanningReadinessProfile{
			KnownStacks:   domain.StudentPlanningReadinessStackValues{State: "answered", Values: &emptyStacks},
			DesiredStacks: domain.StudentPlanningReadinessStackValues{State: "unanswered"},
		},
	}}
	handler := NewHandler(answerRepoStub{}, nil, nil, nil)
	handler.PlanningReadiness = getter
	router := NewRouter(handler, "internal-token")
	path := "/students/" + studentID + "/planning-readiness"
	unauthorized := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(unauthorized, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil))
	if unauthorized.Code != http.StatusForbidden || getter.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("unauthorized status=%d calls=%d", unauthorized.Code, getter.calls)
	}
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil)
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "internal-token")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK || getter.calls != 1 || !bytes.Contains(response.Body.Bytes(), []byte(`"schema":"student-planning-readiness-snapshot.v1"`)) || !bytes.Contains(response.Body.Bytes(), []byte(`"known_stacks":{"state":"answered","values":[]}`)) || bytes.Contains(response.Body.Bytes(), []byte(`"desired_stacks":{"state":"unanswered","values"`)) || response.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d calls=%d cache=%q body=%s", response.Code, getter.calls, response.Header().Get("Cache-Control"), response.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestHandlerGetLearningActionCodeContextUsesInternalToken(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	actionID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	handler := NewHandler(answerRepoStub{}, nil, nil, nil)
	handler.LearningCode = learningActionCodeContextGetterStub{context: domain.LearningActionCodeContext{
		LearningActionID: actionID, StudentID: studentID, TaskID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		Available: true, Files: []domain.LearningActionCodeFile{{Path: "main.go", Content: "package main"}},
		PolicyVersion: domain.LearningActionCodeContextPolicyVersion,
		Validation:    domain.LearningActionValidationObservation{PolicyVersion: domain.SandboxValidationObservationVersion},
	}}
	router := NewRouter(handler, "internal-token")
	path := "/students/" + studentID + "/learning-actions/" + actionID + "/code-context"
	unauthorized := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(unauthorized, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil))
	if unauthorized.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
		t.Fatalf("unauthorized status=%d", unauthorized.Code)
	}
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil)
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "internal-token")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK || !bytes.Contains(response.Body.Bytes(), []byte("package main")) || bytes.Contains(response.Body.Bytes(), []byte("answer_id")) {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestHandlerApplyPracticeEvidenceRequiresTokenAndIdempotencyContract(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	evidenceID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	applier := &practiceEvidenceApplierStub{receipt: domain.PracticeEvidenceReceipt{
		Schema: domain.PracticeEvidenceReceiptSchemaV1, EvidenceID: evidenceID,
		Accepted: true, PolicyVersion: domain.MasteryPolicyVersion,
	}}
	handler := NewHandler(answerRepoStub{}, nil, nil, nil)
	handler.PracticeEvidence = applier
	router := NewRouter(handler, "internal-token")
	body := []byte(`{"schema":"practice-task-competency-evidence.v1"}`)
	path := "/students/" + studentID + "/practice-evidence"

	unauthorized := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(unauthorized, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, path, bytes.NewReader(body)))
	if unauthorized.Code != http.StatusForbidden || applier.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("unauthorized status=%d calls=%d", unauthorized.Code, applier.calls)
	}

	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, path, bytes.NewReader(body))
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "internal-token")
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", evidenceID)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK || applier.calls != 1 || !bytes.Contains(response.Body.Bytes(), []byte(`"accepted":true`)) {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d calls=%d body=%s", response.Code, applier.calls, response.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestHandlerGetTaskProgress(t *testing.T) {
	handler := NewHandler(answerRepoStub{
		progress: map[string]domain.StudentTaskProgress{
			"task-1": {
				TaskID:         "task-1",
				HasPassed:      true,
				LatestStatus:   domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed,
				LatestAnswerID: "answer-1",
			},
			"task-2": {
				TaskID:         "task-2",
				HasUnderReview: true,
				LatestStatus:   domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview,
				LatestAnswerID: "answer-2",
			},
		},
	}, nil, nil, nil)

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/internal/answers/progress?user_id=user-1&task_ids=task-2,task-1", nil)
	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()

	handler.GetTaskProgress(resp, req)

	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d", resp.Code, http.StatusOK)
	}

	var payload struct {
		Items []struct {
			TaskID         string `json:"task_id"`
			HasPassed      bool   `json:"has_passed"`
			HasUnderReview bool   `json:"has_under_review"`
			LatestStatus   int    `json:"latest_status"`
			LatestAnswerID string `json:"latest_answer_id"`
		} `json:"items"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &payload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unmarshal response: %v", err)
	}
	if len(payload.Items) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("items len = %d, want 2", len(payload.Items))
	}
	if payload.Items[0].TaskID != "task-1" || payload.Items[1].TaskID != "task-2" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected task order: %#v", payload.Items)
	}
	if !payload.Items[0].HasPassed {
		t.Fatalf("expected first item to be passed")
	}
	if !payload.Items[1].HasUnderReview {
		t.Fatalf("expected second item to be under review")
	}
}

func TestHandlerGetTaskProgressRequiresParams(t *testing.T) {
	handler := NewHandler(answerRepoStub{}, nil, nil, nil)

	testCases := []struct {
		name string
		url  string
	}{
		{
			name: "missing user id",
			url:  "/internal/answers/progress?task_ids=task-1",
		},
		{
			name: "missing task ids",
			url:  "/internal/answers/progress?user_id=user-1",
		},
	}

	for _, tc := range testCases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, tc.url, nil)
			resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
			handler.GetTaskProgress(resp, req)
			if resp.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
				t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d", resp.Code, http.StatusBadRequest)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestHandlerQueryStudentTargetMastery(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	target := domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.errors"}
	handler := NewHandler(answerRepoStub{}, nil, targetMasteryGetterStub{items: []domain.StudentTargetMastery{
		{
			StudentID:               studentID,
			Target:                  target,
			State:                   domain.TargetMasteryApplied,
			MasteryScore:            1,
			Confidence:              0.33333,
			IndependentSuccessCount: 1,
			EvidenceCount:           1,
			PolicyVersion:           domain.MasteryPolicyVersion,
		},
	}}, nil)
	router := NewRouter(handler, "internal-token")
	body := bytes.NewBufferString(`{"targets":[{"type":"concept","key":"go.errors"}]}`)
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/students/"+studentID+"/mastery/query", body)
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "internal-token")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	var payload struct {
		Items []targetMasteryResponse `json:"items"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &payload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode response: %v", err)
	}
	if len(payload.Items) != 1 || payload.Items[0].State != domain.TargetMasteryApplied || payload.Items[0].EvidenceCount != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected mastery response: %+v", payload.Items)
	}
}

func TestHandlerQueryStudentTargetMasteryRejectsInvalidBody(t *testing.T) {
	handler := NewHandler(answerRepoStub{}, nil, targetMasteryGetterStub{}, nil)
	router := NewRouter(handler, "internal-token")
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/mastery/query", bytes.NewBufferString(`{"targets":[],"unknown":true}`))
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "internal-token")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d, want 400", response.Code)
	}
}

func TestHandlerGetLearningActionContextReturnsSafeSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	actionID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	handler := NewHandler(answerRepoStub{}, nil, nil, learningActionContextGetterStub{context: domain.LearningActionContext{
		LearningActionID: actionID,
		StudentID:        studentID,
		TaskID:           "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		ContextType:      domain.LearningContextLessonTask,
		ContextID:        "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		LearningTargets:  []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.errors"}},
		Status:           domain.LearningActionStatusOpen,
		OpenedAt:         time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}})
	router := NewRouter(handler, "internal-token")
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/students/"+studentID+"/learning-actions/"+actionID+"/context", nil)
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "internal-token")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()

	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)

	if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	if bytes.Contains(response.Body.Bytes(), []byte("outcome")) || bytes.Contains(response.Body.Bytes(), []byte("student_task_answer_id")) {
		t.Fatalf("private action fields leaked: %s", response.Body.String())
	}
	var payload domain.LearningActionContext
	if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &payload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode response: %v", err)
	}
	if payload.LearningActionID != actionID || payload.Status != domain.LearningActionStatusOpen || len(payload.LearningTargets) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected context response: %+v", payload)
	}
}

func TestHandlerGetLearningActionContextHidesMissingOrForeignAction(t *testing.T) {
	handler := NewHandler(answerRepoStub{}, nil, nil, learningActionContextGetterStub{err: domain.ErrNotFound})
	router := NewRouter(handler, "internal-token")
	request := httptest.NewRequest(
		http.MethodGet,
		"/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/learning-actions/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222/context",
		nil,
	)
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "internal-token")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()

	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)

	if response.Code != http.StatusNotFound {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d, want 404", response.Code)
	}
}

func TestHandlerGetLearningActionContextRequiresInternalToken(t *testing.T) {
	handler := NewHandler(answerRepoStub{}, nil, nil, learningActionContextGetterStub{})
	router := NewRouter(handler, "internal-token")
	request := httptest.NewRequest(
		http.MethodGet,
		"/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/learning-actions/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222/context",
		nil,
	)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()

	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)

	if response.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d, want 403", response.Code)
	}
}
